description: This file defines the client-side API for managing roles and permissions in etcd, including role creation, deletion, retrieval, and permission grants/revocations via HTTP.

classes.name: httpAuthRoleAPI
classes.description: Implementation of the AuthRoleAPI interface using HTTP client.

classes.name: authRoleAPIAction
classes.description: Represents an action (add, remove, grant, revoke) on a role for HTTP requests.

classes.name: authRoleAPIList
classes.description: Helper for listing roles via HTTP.

methods.name: ListRoles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all role names.

methods.name: GetRole
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific role.

methods.name: GrantRoleKV
methods.description: Grants a role permissions on specific key prefixes.

methods.name: RevokeRoleKV
methods.description: Revokes permissions from a role on specific key prefixes.
